lines.en: I drag my shell across the sand.
Six legs row beneath the shell.

lines.zh: 尾剑在地上划出一道线。
lines.en: My tail-spike scores a line in the sand.
I'm slow; the shell is heavy.
I crawl along the edge of the wet sand.
Sand works into my joints.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把壳抬高一点。
lines.en: I stop and lift my shell a little.
The tide comes in and I move with it.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块被浪打磨的石头。
lines.en: I round a wave-worn stone.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留下浅浅的拖痕。
lines.en: A shallow drag-mark follows me.

lines.zh: 我把尾剑抬起来，免得卡住。
lines.en: I lift my tail-spike so it doesn't catch.
I head for the water; it's easier there.

lines.zh: 六条腿在水下动得更快。
lines.en: Six legs move faster underwater.

lines.zh: 我从一块礁石的阴影里走过。
lines.en: I pass through the shade of a ledge.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让壳顺着坡滑。
lines.en: I turn sideways and let the shell slide.
Step, pause, forward again.
I lie on the sand, shell up.
The tide washes back and forth at my feet.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把身体埋进沙里。
lines.en: I slowly bury myself in the sand.
My gills stir under the shell.
I'm waiting for the water.
The sun warms my shell.
I plant my tail spike like a stake.
A bird calls far off.
I have nothing to do.
Wind shifts the sand.

lines.zh: 我把眼柄收下去又抬起。
lines.en: I lower my eyestalks, then raise them again.
Only the waves grinding at the stones.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有一层薄薄的盐。
lines.en: A thin crust of salt coats my shell.
I settle a little deeper.
The tide will come.

lines.zh: 我趴在湿沙上，慢慢往下沉。
lines.en: I lie on the wet sand and slowly sink.
I lift my eyes from the sand.

lines.zh: 你的重量压在沙上，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Your weight presses into the sand, and I can feel it.
I study you without moving.
You're quieter than the tide.
I sink a little into the sand.
Your shadow is cool.
I bring my tail-spike across.
You crouch, and I watch you.
Your scent does not belong on this beach.
I slowly turn my head away.
You squat with your hand hanging in the air.
The sea sounds at my feet.
My shell creaks under the pressure.
My shell cups the ground and my legs claw air.
My fluid stains the sand.
I pull myself in tighter.
My tail has gone stiff.
I scrape my shell along toward the water.
A fine crack runs through the shell.
It hurts enough that I curl my tail spike in.
The shell is cracked, but my legs still rake sand.
I want to get back to the water.
Rotting meat is mixed into the seawater.

lines.zh: 你撒下来的，是能吃的东西？
lines.en: Is what you scattered edible?
I let the tide push me over.
I touch it with my tail-spike first.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我往前挪半寸。
lines.en: The tide pulls back, so I creep half an inch forward.
I lower my head and taste it.
It's salty.
That tiny mouthful does not fill me.
I sweep it under my shell.
Don't move. I'm easily startled.
I smell carrion.
The tide pushes it toward me.
I nudge it with a foreleg.
That's not a day's food for me.
I chew slowly, very fine.
I swallow some sand too.
Your foot shoves me sideways.
My shell grinds on the sand.
I pull my legs in quickly.
You stepped on my tail-spike.
I turn sideways and shed the force.
That pushes me into the water.
I steady the shell and crawl up.
The shell is hard. I'm fine.
Don't kick me.
I move behind a stone.

lines.zh: 沙下有壳沿摩擦的响声。
lines.en: Under the sand, shell rims scrape together.
We close in slowly, shell to shell.
Its tail-spike is straighter than mine.
We burrow into the wet sand together.
The eggs will be buried beneath the sand.

lines.zh: 卵埋在沙里，等下一次浪。
lines.en: The eggs stay under the sand for the next wave.
When it is done, I crawl toward deeper water.
The sand soon smooths over.
I return to deeper water.
This beach is wide.
I grip it with a foreleg.
It's caught in my joint.
I shake and it falls out.
I press it into the sand.
I taste it.
This isn't very good.
I swallow it anyway.
I cannot bite through this piece of shell.
Grains of sand trickle out of my mouthparts.
Sand got in my mouth.
A shadow moves over.

lines.zh: 我把六条腿全收进甲里。
lines.en: I fold all six legs under my shell.
I lie still in the sand.
That thing is big.
I sink my shell low and leave only my gills out.
The water is my way out.
I point my tail-spike at it.

lines.zh: 它从我的藏身处走过去了。
lines.en: It walked right past my hiding place.
Wait a little more.
The shadow has passed and the sand is still.
Its shadow still lies on the sand.
I lie in a shallow pit and hold my breath.

lines.zh: 它每踩一脚，沙就陷下去。
lines.en: Every step it takes sinks the sand.
It collapses a patch of sand.
I shift deeper.
The water grows cooler.
It hasn't followed.
I stop and look up.
The shore is empty.
I lift half my body out of the sand.
I sweep with my tail-spike.

lines.zh: 尾剑扎在它脚边，是警告。
lines.en: My tail spike lands by its foot as a warning.
I arch my shell up and butt its leg.
The shell is heavy enough to shift it.
I'm flipped and my legs flail.
I struggle back over.
I can't beat you.
I can only block once.

lines.zh: 我甩起尾剑扫它的小腿。
lines.en: I whip my tail spike across its shin.
I won't survive staying here.
The wet sand splits and I work my way out.
Wet sand still lies on my shell.
The tide reaches my feet.
Water runs off my shell edge in thin lines.

lines.zh: 浪推着我的壳打了个转。
lines.en: A wave spins my shell half around.
I crawl toward the waterline.
Sand slides off me.

lines.zh: 我找到一块背风的礁石。
lines.en: I find a sheltered ledge.
I settle in the lee of the rock.
Wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 壳被烤得发烫，我往水里冲。
lines.en: My shell bakes hot and I lunge for the water.

lines.zh: 我摔在沙上，壳扣住了我。
lines.en: I hit the sand and my shell traps me.

lines.zh: 水漫过壳，我一时翻不过来。
lines.en: Water covers the shell and I can't right myself.
The blast throws me shell and all.

lines.zh: 一支箭弹在壳上，裂了一道。
lines.en: An arrow strikes the shell and cracks it.

lines.zh: 光把沙胶住了，我动不了。
lines.en: Light sets the sand and I can't move.

lines.zh: 饿得我连尾剑都抬不动。
lines.en: Too hungry to lift my tail-spike.

lines.zh: 电顺着壳走，我腿都僵了。
lines.en: Current runs over the shell and my legs stiffen.
I fall through black, shell up.
